#: Base language. Every key in use must have a text here: other languages fall back to it.
#keys: A key is a latin label, never a sentence. Substitution is by name: %(name)s.
#adding: A new section goes into a NEW FILE in this folder - no existing file is rewritten.
#section: The launch window morphbench.exe. It reads these files itself, without python.
launcher.browseHint: Browse folder: meshes with morph files are looked for under it
launcher.foreignServer: the server was started outside MO2 and cannot see the meshes of the build: stop it and start one from here
launcher.handingOver: the server is up - handing the root over…
launcher.killed: the server did not exit within %(seconds)s s - killing it
launcher.noModule: no %(script)s beside it: give the folder of the module as an argument or in the MORPHBENCH_HOME variable
launcher.noPageNoServer: the server is not up - there is no page to open
launcher.noPython: python.exe not found: give its path in the MORPHBENCH_PYTHON variable or the "python" key in morphbench.json
launcher.notMorphbench: whatever answers at %(url)s is not morphbench
launcher.portTaken: the port is taken by another program: %(url)s - change servePort in morphbench.json
launcher.rootRemembered: the root is remembered; the server is not up - it will take the folder when it starts
launcher.stateBusy: the port is taken by another program  %(url)s
launcher.stateSlow: someone is there but does not answer  %(url)s  (a server walking a large folder?)
